skills.name: Issue analysis
skills.instructions: Summarize expected and actual behavior, reproduction steps and acceptance criteria from the selected GitHub issue. Use the MCP connector tools selected for this skill to retrieve sources. If no connector tools or source material are available, explain what information is needed.

skills.name: Repository navigation
skills.instructions: Read the selected issue, locate relevant modules in the pinned tree and inspect source before explaining responsibilities. Start with source paths mentioned by the issue or upstream report. Use the MCP connector tools selected for this skill to retrieve sources. If no connector tools or source material are available, explain what information is needed.

skills.name: Change impact analysis
skills.instructions: Inspect source related to the issue. Explain directly affected files, plausible downstream effects and proposed changes. Source claims need inspected file evidence; mark unverified dependency effects as hypotheses. Use the MCP connector tools selected for this skill to retrieve sources. If no connector tools or source material are available, explain what information is needed.

skills.name: Regression test planning
skills.instructions: Use upstream issue and source-impact findings to propose concrete regression tests, edge cases and expected outcomes. Do not claim tests were run.

skills.name: Compatibility and risk review
skills.instructions: Review upstream findings for compatibility risks, uncertainty, incomplete coverage and unsupported assumptions.

skills.name: Repository release briefing
skills.instructions: Summarize recent repository releases and flag relevant compatibility changes. State when the source does not establish relevance to the issue. Use the MCP connector tools selected for this skill to retrieve sources. If no connector tools or source material are available, explain what information is needed.

skills.name: RSS analysis
skills.instructions: Summarize recent feed items, identify themes and preserve source links. Distinguish facts from inferred relevance. Use the MCP connector tools selected for this skill to retrieve sources. If no connector tools or source material are available, explain what information is needed.

skills.name: Hacker News analysis
skills.instructions: Summarize the retrieved stories and discussion metadata. Explain potential engineering relevance as inference, preserving links and uncertainty. Use the MCP connector tools selected for this skill to retrieve sources. If no connector tools or source material are available, explain what information is needed.

skills.name: Evidence review
skills.instructions: Audit upstream findings against retrieved evidence. Identify unsupported claims, incomplete retrieval and uncertain file impact. Cite inherited evidence; do not invent facts.

skills.name: Combined briefing
skills.instructions: Combine completed upstream findings into a coherent engineering report. Include issue summary, affected files, proposed changes, tests, risks and uncertainty when provided. Separate repository evidence from broader news context.
